title: Chicken Joo muna, adulting ulit pagkatapos
excerpt: May cravings? Take a chicken break before getting back to your day.
body: Pag may cravings, biglang may “budget adjustment.” Chicken Joo muna, adulting ulit pagkatapos.
Choose a chicken meal for yourself or a box to share. Find your nearest Chicken Joo branch and make a little time for lunch.

title: A little Joo time for our teachers
excerpt: After a day spent teaching, take a little time for yourself. Happy World Teachers’ Day from Chicken Joo.
body: To the teachers who prepare lessons, answer questions, and keep showing up for their students: thank you.
This World Teachers’ Day, take a break from the lesson plan. Share a chicken meal with your fellow teachers or enjoy a little Joo time on your own.
Happy World Teachers’ Day from Chicken Joo. Find a branch near you for your next chicken break.

title: Kainang mahalaga, moments na masarap balikan
excerpt: Pass the chicken box around and catch up with the people at your table.
body: Kainang mahalaga, moments na masarap balikan.
Bring a chicken box to the table and give the kwentuhan a little more time. Choose your flavors together, add your favorite sides, and share a Chicken Joo meal.

title: Chicken Joo for your stay-at-home plans
excerpt: Movie night or lunch at your desk? Check delivery options for your nearest Chicken Joo branch.
body: May cravings, pero stay-at-home ang plano? A Chicken Joo meal fits right into lunch at your desk or a movie with the barkada.
Check GrabFood or foodpanda for participating branches at your address. The app shows the available menu, delivery area, and fees.
Choose a solo chicken meal for lunch. If everyone’s joining in, browse the sharing boxes and agree on your flavors before ordering.
Delivery availability and prices vary by branch and service. Use the branch page to find a nearby location; this website’s checkout saves pickup selections only.

title: Busy sa work? Take a Joo break.
excerpt: Put lunch on the schedule. A two-flavor chicken box gives the team something to share.
body: The meeting can run long, but lunch still needs a place on the schedule. Take a few minutes away from the screen for a Chicken Joo break.
Sharing with your ka-work? Choose a 14-piece two-flavor box so everyone gets a say. Original and Yangnyeom make one pair to try.
Each chicken box lists its available flavors on the menu. Add Japanese rice or Joomami Fries separately to build the meal you want.
Pass the box around and catch up over lunch. If you’re ordering through a delivery service, check the branch’s current menu and prices there.

title: Team citrus or team spicy?
excerpt: Yuja Orange and Yangnyeom Super Spicy bring two different flavors to the chicken conversation.
body: Yuja Orange brings a citrus twist. Yangnyeom Super Spicy brings the heat. This flavor spotlight gives you two ideas for your next chicken break.
Send the artwork to your usual food buddy and compare picks. You might agree on one flavor or each have a favorite to ask about.
Browse the current menu for solo meals and sharing boxes. The flavor choices listed with each dish show what you can select online.
These campaign flavors may differ from the current menu. Check with your branch for availability and prices before planning your order.

title: A little love from a ka-Joo
excerpt: Lovely’s featured review gives the chicken and the rice a shout-out. Salamat for coming back for another Chicken Joo meal.
body: Our ka-Joo Lovely has a few favorites, including Yangnyeom, spicy chicken, garlic, and Korean barbecue. Her featured review gives the rice some love, too.
“kahit rice nila super sarap! worth your money talaga.” — Lovely, from the foodpanda review featured above.
Salamat, Lovely, and our San Fernando Downtown ka-Joos. We’re glad Chicken Joo has a place in your lunch plans.
Have a favorite flavor of your own? Share your experience with the branch you visited. Your next ka-Joo might find their first chicken meal through your recommendation.

title: Hit pause for a Chicken Joo break
excerpt: Step away from the keyboard for boneless chicken and rice. Choose your flavor and make time for lunch.
body: That keyboard break button would come in handy. Until then, step away from the screen and make lunch a Chicken Joo break.
Start with a chicken-and-rice meal, then choose your flavor. Each dish lists its choices so you can find your usual pick or try another.
Keep it Original, go with Yangnyeom, or try the spicy or garlic option when available. Your meal options show the current selection.
Find a branch near your next lunch stop. A little time for chicken and rice makes a welcome pause between the morning’s work and the afternoon’s plans.

title: Yangnyeom, Korean Barbecue, or Snow Cheese?
excerpt: Three flavors from the Chicken Joo spotlight. Pick the one you’d ask about on your next branch visit.
body: Yangnyeom, Korean Barbecue, and Snow Cheese take a turn in the spotlight. Share the artwork with the barkada and compare your picks.
Yangnyeom has its red glaze. Korean Barbecue has a darker finish with sesame, while Snow Cheese has a pale coating. Each tray brings a different look to the table.
Planning a meal together? Browse the chicken boxes and choose a portion for your group. Add rice or fries separately if you want sides.
The gallery includes flavors beyond the current online selection. Check each dish’s choices on the menu, and ask your branch about other flavors and prices.

title: Get to know the campaign flavors
excerpt: Salted Egg, Yangnyeom Super Spicy, and Yuja Orange take their turn in the Chicken Joo spotlight.
body: Salted Egg, Yangnyeom Super Spicy, and Yuja Orange bring three choices to this Chicken Joo campaign. Which one would you ask about first?
Salted Egg is the golden-coated tray in the artwork. Yangnyeom Super Spicy has the glossy red finish, and Yuja Orange brings the citrus-inspired option.
The artwork features rice meals and sharing portions. Use it as inspiration for your next branch visit, then check the current menu for dishes you can order.
These flavors appeared in a limited-time campaign. Ask your branch about current availability and prices before choosing a special.
